description: Windows Performance Toolkit from the Windows ADK, including WPA, WPAExporter, WPRUI, and Xperf.
notes: This non-portable package installs the Windows Performance Toolkit system-wide through the Microsoft ADK installer.
It installs only OptionId.WindowsPerformanceToolkit, not Windows PE or deployment tools.
The 10.1.26100.2454 ADK line supports Windows 10 and Windows 11. The newer 10.1.28000.1 ADK line is only for Windows 11 26H1 Arm64.
Administrator rights are required. Tools are installed under C:\Program Files (x86)\Windows Kits\10\Windows Performance Toolkit.
pre_install: if (-not (is_admin)) { abort "`n[ERROR] $app requires admin rights to $cmd." }

script: if (!(Test-Path $target)) { warn "Expected WPT tool not found: $target"; continue }
if (-not (is_admin)) { abort "`n[ERROR] $app requires admin rights to $cmd." }
